store.title: Settings
store.general_subtitle: Your store's name, logo and currency, wherever they show.
store.logo_hint: Shown in your storefront's header and footer, on shipping labels and in the WhatsApp chat. A PNG with a transparent background looks best; your theme decides its size and position. Without a logo, your store's name is shown.
store.currency_symbol_hint: How prices are written on your storefront, such as دج. Set how other languages write it below, such as DA in French and English.
store.seo_subtitle: How your store shows in search results and when its link is shared.
store.meta_title_placeholder: Page title shown in browser tabs and search results
store.meta_desc_placeholder: Brief description shown in search results (max 500 chars)...
store.share_image_hint: Shown when a link to your store is shared on Facebook, WhatsApp or Messenger. Best at 1200 × 630 pixels. A page with its own image, such as a product or a landing page, shows that one instead.
store.save_error: Failed to save. Please try again.
store.domain_hint: Your storefront's custom domain. Landing page share URLs are built from it. Leave empty to use the deployment's default storefront URL.
store.delivery_pricing_subtitle: Free-delivery threshold and how a multi-product basket is charged
store.free_shipping_threshold_hint: Every order whose subtotal — after offers and coupons — reaches this amount ships free, on your store and in orders you enter. Leave empty for no free delivery. Offers and coupons can also make delivery free.
store.free_shipping_threshold_invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty to turn this off.
store.cart_shipping_mode_label: Basket with items from different shipping profiles
store.cart_shipping_mode_hint: Only applies when a basket mixes products that ship differently. A single-product order is unaffected.
store.cart_shipping_mode_highest_label: Charge the highest rate in the basket
store.cart_shipping_mode_highest_hint: The customer pays the rate of the item that costs most to ship. Your margin is never reduced by a cheaper item.
store.cart_shipping_mode_default_profile_hint: Per-product shipping profiles are ignored for baskets. Simplest promise if everything ships the same way.
store.cart_subtitle: Let customers order several products in one go
store.cart_enabled_hint: Off by default. Your storefront keeps its one-click order form either way.
store.cart_enabled_note: "Add to cart" appears next to your order form — it does not replace it. Customers buying a single product keep the same one-step checkout. A customer with several products confirms them together on a checkout page.
store.languages_subtitle: The languages your storefront is offered in. Add a language, translate, then publish it.

shipping.title: Shipping rates
shipping.subtitle: Set delivery fees per wilaya for home delivery and stop-desk pickup
shipping.no_profile_description: Create a shipping profile to set per-wilaya delivery rates. These rates will be auto-suggested when creating new orders.
shipping.confirm_delete: Delete this profile and all its rates?
shipping.set_as_default_hint: Auto-suggest these rates when creating new orders
shipping.linked_company_hint: Associate this rate card with a specific delivery company
shipping.fetch_error_not_connected: This company is not connected — add API credentials first
shipping.import_company_rates_hint: Fill the table below with this company's pricing data
shipping.import_no_pricing: This company has no pricing data to import
shipping.list_empty_description: Create a rate card to define per-wilaya delivery prices for your drivers and companies.

languages.remove_description: Its translations of your products, categories, offers and store text are deleted when you save.
languages.default_description: Your storefront opens in it. Content isn't translated automatically: your products' own text stays as you wrote it, so check it reads well in this language.
languages.add_hint: It starts unpublished, so shoppers don't see it until you publish it.
